thread:
zoe (design): Quick UX pass on the autoscale compact card. Main asks: clarify burst billing language and make guardrail state non-color dependent.
raj (product): thanks. we should avoid "charges" alone. prefer softer phrasing that still warns.
leo (eng): technical note: the compact card is in a recycled list; any tooltip should be lightweight and not remount the DOM tree.
zoe (design): proposed burst copy: "Burst: temporary capacity — additional charges possible." CTA: "How burst affects billing" linking to docs.
nana (a11y): typo on name: ana here. A11y notes: info icons need 44px hit area and visible label for screen readers. Tooltips must be dismissible via Esc and have aria-describedby.
leo (eng): will implement 18px icon + padding to reach 44px. Agree on Esc dismiss and tap-only on touch.
zoe (design): guardrail visual: small "Guardrail" chip + diagonal pattern when active, with tooltip "Guardrail active: autoscaler prioritizes latency target; may use extra capacity."
raj (product): can we avoid numerical cost estimates for now? yes. keep qualitative language.
nana (a11y): use aria-live="polite" for guardrail state changes, debounce 1s to avoid screen reader spam. Also ensure color is not the only cue.
leo (eng): noted. we'll debounce events and add an accessible status element.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging/autoscale-ux-v3 -> in ~8m
raj (product): folks, please test staging keyboard flow and mobile stacking; flag any missed aria hooks.
zoe (design): thanks everyone — I'll update Figma and paste final copy here after deploy. :thumbsup:
